system.description:
Healing spells and brewed potions restore an additional +1 HP per die, and once per day you may cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without expending a slot.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
